dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。ご準備が宜しければぼたんさんのタイミングでお知らせくださいね。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming today. When you're ready, please let me know in your own time.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、11時からお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'd like to start at 11:00.

dialogue.content: 時間になりました。始めさせて頂きますね。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: It's time. Let's begin. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 相談は
dialogue.English: My concern is...

dialogue.content: 今の職場の事です
dialogue.English: It's about my current workplace.

dialogue.content: 職場の事でお悩みなんですね。詳しく聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I see, you're troubled about something at your workplace. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: はい。今の職場は派遣されて行ってます。上司のイジメに困惑しています
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm working at my current job through a temp agency. I'm distressed by bullying from my supervisor.

dialogue.content: 派遣先の上司の方がいじめを・・。それはお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: So it's bullying from your supervisor at your current placement... That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: どのようないじめですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of bullying is it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです、辛いです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. It's painful.

dialogue.content: どのような･･･
dialogue.English: What kind...

dialogue.content: はい、具体的にどのような事をされたんですか？聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, could you tell me specifically what they have done? Would you be willing to share?

dialogue.content: えっと、仕事の説明がわかりにくくて、聞こうとすると適当にあしらわれて･･･
dialogue.English: Well, their work explanations are unclear, and when I try to ask questions, I'm just brushed off...

dialogue.content: 仕事が進まない
dialogue.English: I can't make progress on my work.

dialogue.content: ええ、それはひどいですね・・仕事が進まないほどなんですよね・・
dialogue.English: I see, that sounds awful... To the point where you can't get your work done.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: もし差し支えなければ、年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 私のですか？
dialogue.English: Mine?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私は、30代女性です。
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。とてもつらい状況なのですが、派遣のお仕事はどのようなお仕事をされているんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. I know this is a very difficult situation, but what kind of work do you do as a temporary employee?

dialogue.content: はい、大学の人事課で事務の仕事をしています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I do administrative work in a university's HR department.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。人事課で事務だと、どうしても上司の方と接触必要になりますものね・・
dialogue.English: I see. Working in administration in the HR department, you would inevitably need to interact with your supervisor, wouldn't you...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 上司の方以外には誰か聞けるような方はいらっしゃらないのですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone besides your supervisor you can ask?

dialogue.content: 話が聞ける方･･･人事課の方はたくさんいるのですが、その上司と私は２人部署で区分けされていているので、聞ける方は上司のさらに上司の課長です
dialogue.English: Someone I can talk to... There are many people in the HR department, but my supervisor and I are in a two-person section, so the only other person I could ask is my supervisor's supervisor, the section manager.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、上司のさらに上司ともなると、敷居も高くなってしまう感じでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I see. Going to your supervisor's supervisor might feel a bit intimidating, I imagine...

dialogue.content: そうですね･･･ましてや私は、派遣の身分なので言いにくいですね。
dialogue.English: Yes... Especially since I'm a temp, it's hard to speak up.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、言いにくい所もありますよね。聴いても適当にあしらわれる。他に嫌だと感じる事ありますか？
dialogue.English: I can understand that it's difficult to speak up. You get brushed off when you ask questions. Is there anything else that you find upsetting?

dialogue.content: 先程の続きになりますが、説明はぶくくせに、私が察して印刷してると｢それ違うから｣と怒られる。最初から説明して欲しいと思います。
dialogue.English: This is related to what I said earlier, but even though they omit the explanation, when I try to guess and print something out, they get angry and say, 'That's wrong.' I just wish they would explain it properly from the beginning.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、説明不足なのに、怒られるのは納得いかなく感じますよね・・
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely understandable that you'd feel it's unfair to be scolded when you weren't given a proper explanation.

dialogue.content: 怒られた時はさすがに凹みました。私が悪いのか不安になって、派遣登録している担当の方にも伝えました。
dialogue.English: When I was scolded, I felt really down. I got worried that maybe I was the one at fault, so I told my representative at the temp agency.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。伝えられて、どのような返事だったんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What did they say when you told them?

dialogue.content: その担当の方は、現場にはいないので現状を把握してないので｢様子見て欲しい｣と言われました。
dialogue.English: My representative isn't on-site, so they don't know the full situation. They just told me to 'wait and see'.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、様子見て欲しいとだけ言われたんですね。それを聞いてどう思われましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... so they just told you to 'wait and see.' How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: 話したことで、孤独な感じはなくなりましたが、仕方ないかなと思いました。
dialogue.English: Talking about it made me feel less alone, but I also felt like there was nothing that could be done.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。話してみて少しは楽にはなったとはゆえ、仕方ないと向き合おうとされてる様子が、頑張ってらっしゃると感じます。
dialogue.English: I see. Even though talking about it helped a little, the way you're trying to accept it as a situation that can't be helped shows how hard you're trying to cope.

dialogue.content: その今の職場はいつからお勤めなんですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been at your current workplace?

dialogue.content: 今の職場は9月からです。
dialogue.English: I started in September.

dialogue.content: 二か月半ほどなんですね。
dialogue.English: So, about two and a half months.

dialogue.content: はい。派遣登録して初めての仕事です。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's my first assignment since registering with the agency.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。初めての事ばかりで分からない事だらけですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Since it's your first assignment, everything must be new and unfamiliar.

dialogue.content: 派遣の担当の方にも、上司の事勇気を出してお話になられましたよね。
dialogue.English: And you gathered the courage to talk to your agency representative about your supervisor, didn't you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。派遣先の人の事も知らないし、仕事だけしに行ってる感じです。
dialogue.English: That's right. I don't know the people at the company, so it feels like I just go there to do my job.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、直ぐに誰かに相談できる人が居る環境ではない中、上司さんのその対応はお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. In an environment where you don't have anyone you can easily talk to, your supervisor's behavior must be especially difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですね、味方がいないって感じです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it feels like I don't have any allies.

dialogue.content: うんうん、味方が居ないのはそうゆう時辛いですよね。一方で派遣のいい所はなにか思う所ありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. It's painful to feel like you don't have any allies in that kind of situation. On the other hand, are there any good aspects you've found about being a temporary worker?

dialogue.content: そうですね、今の所辛い面しか体験出来てないので、いいところは思い浮かばないです。
dialogue.English: Well, so far I've only experienced the difficult side of it, so I can't think of anything good.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。派遣で働こうと思ったきっかけなどありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What made you decide to work as a temp?

dialogue.content: はい。3月で仕事を辞めてから正社員の仕事がなかなか決まらず、どんな形態でも仕事をしたいと思って応募したら受かったから始めました。
dialogue.English: Yes. I quit my job in March and couldn't find a full-time position. I wanted to work in any capacity, so I applied for this and got it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。正社員を希望はされていたけど、仕方なくって所もあってという感じなんですね。なれない派遣で頑張っておられるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you were hoping for a full-time position, but ended up taking this out of necessity. You're working hard in this unfamiliar role as a temp worker.

dialogue.content: 少しお話させてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.English: May I share a thought with you?

dialogue.content: 時間があまりないのですが･･･
dialogue.English: I don't have much time left...

dialogue.content: そうですね、時間がきてしまいましたね。お話聞くしか出来ませんでしたが、これで終了させて頂きますね
dialogue.English: You're right, our time is up. I was only able to listen, but we'll have to end here for today.

dialogue.content: 色々お話聞いていただきましてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for listening.

dialogue.content: 上司さんにちゃんと説明してもらえる日がきますように。派遣の方にも相談して溜め込まないように、また困ったらいらしてくださいね。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I hope the day comes when your supervisor explains things properly. Please continue to talk with your agency representative so you don't bottle things up, and please come back if you need to talk again. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました終了ボタンを押させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. I'll press the end button now.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: You as well. Thank you.
